description: This file defines interfaces for system management, discovery, configuration, lifetime management, and metadata within the WPEFramework's Controller namespace. It contains pure virtual classes with methods for rebooting, deleting, cloning, environment querying, discovery, configuration persistence, plugin lifecycle management, and metadata retrieval, intended for implementation by other components.
external_methods: Core::hresult Clone(const string& callsign, const string& newcallsign, string& response)
Core::hresult Environment(const string& index, string& environment) const
Core::hresult Configuration(const string& callsign, string& configuration) const
Core::hresult Configuration(const string& callsign, const string& configuration)
Core::hresult Hibernate(const string& callsign, const Core::hresult timeout)
Core::hresult Status(const string& index, string& response)
Core::hresult CallStack(const string& index, string& callstack)

classes.name: ISystemManagement
classes.description: Interface for system management operations such as rebooting, deleting directories, cloning plugins, and retrieving environment variables.

classes.name: IDiscovery
classes.description: Interface for network discovery operations, including starting discovery and retrieving results.

classes.name: IConfiguration
classes.description: Interface for configuration management, including persisting configuration and retrieving or setting configuration values.

classes.name: ILifeTime
classes.description: Interface for managing plugin lifecycle states, including activation, deactivation, suspension, resumption, and notifications.

classes.name: ILifeTime::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for plugin state changes.

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface for retrieving metadata about proxies, status, links, process info, subsystems, version, and call stacks.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes contents of a directory from persistent storage.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a clone of a plugin with a new callsign.

methods.name: Environment
methods.description: Provides the value of a request environment variable.

methods.name: Persist
methods.description: Stores the current configuration to persistent memory.

methods.name: Configuration (getter)
methods.description: Retrieves configuration value for a given callsign.

methods.name: Configuration (setter)
methods.description: Sets configuration value for a given callsign.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification sink for lifetime events.

methods.name: Hibernate
methods.description: Sets a plugin into Hibernate state with a timeout.

methods.name: Proxies
methods.description: Provides details of currently running proxies.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Provides status of a plugin, including configurations.

methods.name: CallStack
methods.description: Provides call stack information for a given thread index.
